clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 空客CEO：需求强劲，订单积压超9200架飞机
title_lines: 供应链挑战下仍推进增产

subtitles.en: Is the demand story looking okay at the moment?
subtitles.zh: 目前需求情况看起来还好吗？

subtitles.en: I've got a goal for that's getting worse. I've got an all price that's at 90 bucks a barrel.
subtitles.zh: 我的目标在承压，油价到了90美元一桶。

subtitles.en: Any sign at this show that consumers is starting to get a little bit more cautious again?
subtitles.zh: 这次展会有没有迹象显示消费者又开始变得谨慎？

subtitles.en: Well, it's the first day of the show and it started very strongly.
subtitles.zh: 今天是展会第一天，开局非常强劲。

subtitles.en: We still see a very strong demand for our products.
subtitles.zh: 我们仍然看到产品需求非常旺盛。

subtitles.en: We have a backlog of more than 9,200 aircraft and we continue to get fresh orders for our short-distance aircraft.
subtitles.zh: 我们有超过9200架飞机的积压订单，短途飞机还在不断获得新订单。

subtitles.en: We have a long range aircraft. The middle is crisis is actually fooling some demand because price of oil is very high
subtitles.zh: 我们有远程飞机。中间危机实际上因为油价高企而催生了一些需求，
en_highlights: price of oil is very high

subtitles.en: and fully efficient aircraft are in more demand. Do you like the economy right now and do you get a sense that what we say at the moment is sustainable?
subtitles.zh: 高效飞机更受欢迎。您喜欢当前的经济状况吗？您觉得目前的情况可持续吗？

subtitles.en: It's a, or are you starting to get a little bit nervous?
subtitles.zh: 还是您开始有点紧张了？

subtitles.en: Well, it's a very complex economy. It's a very complex world, very fast-changing, very unpredictable, but we have more visibility
subtitles.zh: 嗯，经济非常复杂。世界非常复杂，变化极快，难以预测，但我们的可见度更高。

subtitles.en: than others with the backlog we have with a very strong demand for transport, for commercial aviation and with defense.
subtitles.zh: 相比其他公司，我们的订单积压量很大，运输、商业航空和防务领域需求强劲。

subtitles.en: So I think given the environment, we can't complain.
subtitles.zh: 所以，在当前环境下，我们没什么可抱怨的。

subtitles.en: Okay, quite a bit of visibility. So you've got a really big backlog, particularly of the narrow-body aircraft.
subtitles.zh: 好的，可见度很高。你们的订单积压很大，尤其是窄体飞机。

subtitles.en: You'd like to produce more of them, but you're struggling. You've got well-documented engine issues.
subtitles.zh: 你们想增产，但遇到了困难，发动机问题众所周知。

subtitles.en: You and I have joked in the past about building gliders.
subtitles.zh: 我们以前开玩笑说造滑翔机。

subtitles.en: You'd like to produce a rate 75, but you probably can't.
subtitles.zh: 你们想达到月产75架，但可能做不到。

subtitles.en: So what rate can you produce at? What are you doing right now?
subtitles.zh: 那你们实际能生产多少？现在在做什么？

In a recent interview with CNBC, Guillaume Faury, CEO, Airbus, highlighted the aircraft manufacturer's surging demand and the supply chain constraints that are currently hindering production. According to Faury, Airbus has a backlog of more than 8,000 aircraft to deliver in the coming years, surpassing the number of planes it has produced. While demand remains strong, the company's ability to ramp up production is limited by supply chain bottlenecks, primarily due to delays from key suppliers. Faury emphasized that Airbus is experiencing constraints in increasing production speed due to supply issues, particularly with engine manufacturers and aerostructure suppliers. results.title: Airbus CEO says demand stable despite industry challenges
results.snippet: # Airbus CEO says demand stable despite industry challenges. Investing.com -- Airbus CEO Guillaume Faury said Tuesday that the company is not seeing any demand for cancellations or deferrals of jet orders despite recent challenges facing the airline industry. Carriers have been forced into costly detours, but Faury said this has not led to any meaningful reduction in orders. The CEO said Airbus is in a "much better place in terms of supply chain now" but acknowledged that some supply chain issues remain. He expressed frustration with Pratt and Whitney, stating that the company might fall short of its production goal depending on engine deliveries from the supplier. Airbus is targeting a production rate of 75 aircraft in 2027, which Faury said will depend on engine delivery schedules. He added that the company faces a record second half of the year.
